name: Narrator
text: Kyra flips through the pages, deciphering its cryptic notes.

name: Kyra
text: These entries… they’re so scattered, almost frantic.

name: Kyra
text: His name is everywhere mentioned and signed on this Journal.. but.. why would it be hidden under.. the Captain’s pillow?

name: Narrator
text: Says Kyra, giving the impression that Tom might have been a victim after the Captain and other passengers before him. She squints at the strange symbols and jumbled thoughts filling the pages.

name: Kyra
text: What did the Captain and Tom know?

name: Kyra
text: What did they investigate so desperately to end up writing this Journal full of.. cryptomessages?

name: Kyra
text: How many other victims were involved into this very well-calculated chaotic nightmare?
